title: 鉛心橡膠支承隔震
summary: 從週期移轉與設計反應譜出發，以雙線性模型量化鉛心橡膠支承的特徵強度、屈服後勁度、等效週期與阻尼，再處理疊層橡膠的形狀係數與應變、安裝初始偏移、常時約束與隔震縫、原型與量產試驗、振動台驗證、材料性質上下限與震後檢查，並以紐西蘭最早的隔震橋、金門大橋引道高架橋改造與 921 地震後的集鹿大橋研究為例。
summaryEn: Starting from period shift and the design spectrum, use a bilinear model to quantify a lead-rubber bearing's characteristic strength, post-yield stiffness, effective period and damping, then handle laminated-rubber shape factor and strains, initial installation offset, service restraint and isolation gaps, prototype and production tests, shake-table verification, property bounds and post-earthquake inspection, drawing on New Zealand's first isolated bridges, the Golden Gate Bridge approach-viaduct retrofit and post-Chi-Chi studies of the Chi-Lu Bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某連續梁橋每座墩承載 W = 6,000 kN，設兩顆鉛心橡膠支承，每顆 W = 3,000 kN。支承直徑 800 mm、鉛心 150 mm、橡膠總厚 T_r = 200 mm、G = 0.4 MPa，得 Q_d = 10 MPa×0.0177 m² ≈ 177 kN、K_d = 400×0.485/0.2 ≈ 970 kN/m、K_u ≈ 9,700 kN/m、D_y ≈ 0.020 m。設計譜 S_D1 = 0.6 g。先假設 D = 0.25 m：K_eff = 177/0.25 + 970 ≈ 1,678 kN/m，T_eff = 2π√(3,000/(9.81×1,678)) ≈ 2.68 s，β = 2×177×(0.25 − 0.020)/(π×1,678×0.25²) ≈ 24.7%，B_L = (0.247/0.05)^0.3 ≈ 1.61，D = 0.25×0.6×2.68/1.61 ≈ 0.249 m，與假設相符而收斂。每顆支承剪力 V = K_eff·D ≈ 1,678×0.249 ≈ 418 kN，約為 W 的 14%；若同一墩固接、週期 0.63 s 落在譜高原段（教學假設 S_DS = 1.0 g），彈性剪力約為 W 的 100%。若改用 β = 5% 的無鉛心橡膠支承，位移增為約 0.40 m，隔震縫與伸縮縫都要放大。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: each pier of a continuous girder bridge carries W = 6,000 kN on two lead-rubber bearings of W = 3,000 kN each. Bearing diameter 800 mm, lead core 150 mm, total rubber T_r = 200 mm and G = 0.4 MPa give Q_d = 10 MPa×0.0177 m² ≈ 177 kN, K_d = 400×0.485/0.2 ≈ 970 kN/m, K_u ≈ 9,700 kN/m and D_y ≈ 0.020 m. The design spectrum has S_D1 = 0.6 g. Assume D = 0.25 m: K_eff = 177/0.25 + 970 ≈ 1,678 kN/m, T_eff = 2π√(3,000/(9.81×1,678)) ≈ 2.68 s, β = 2×177×(0.25 − 0.020)/(π×1,678×0.25²) ≈ 24.7%, B_L = (0.247/0.05)^0.3 ≈ 1.61 and D = 0.25×0.6×2.68/1.61 ≈ 0.249 m, matching the assumption, so it converges. Bearing shear V = K_eff·D ≈ 1,678×0.249 ≈ 418 kN, about 14% of W; if the same pier were fixed with a 0.63 s period on the spectral plateau (teaching assumption S_DS = 1.0 g), elastic shear would be about 100% of W. Using plain rubber bearings with β = 5% would raise displacement to about 0.40 m and enlarge both isolation gaps and expansion joints. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「週期移轉與荷載路徑」與「等效線性化與設計位移」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Period shift and load path" and "Equivalent linearisation and design displacement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 週期移轉與荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Period shift and load path: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隔震週期 T_eff」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Isolated period T_eff” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一般連續梁橋以固定或彈性支承連到橋墩，整體週期常落在 0.3 至 1.0 s，正好在設計反應譜的高原段，墩柱必須以塑性變形消散地震能量。隔震把上部結構放在水平方向很柔、豎向很硬的鉛心橡膠支承上，使週期拉長到約 2 至 3 s，譜加速度大幅下降；代價是上部結構相對橋墩的位移增加到數十公分，必須由支承、隔震縫與伸縮縫吸收。荷載路徑因此變成「上部慣性力 → 支承剪力 → 墩頂 → 基礎」，墩柱可保持彈性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隔震週期 T_eff」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A conventional continuous girder bridge is tied to its piers through fixed or elastic bearings, and its period typically falls between 0.3 and 1.0 s, right on the plateau of the design spectrum, so the columns must dissipate earthquake energy by yielding. Isolation sets the superstructure on lead-rubber bearings that are very flexible horizontally and very stiff vertically, lengthening the period to about 2 to 3 s and sharply cutting spectral acceleration; the price is a superstructure displacement relative to the piers of tens of centimetres, which bearings, isolation gaps and expansion joints must absorb. The load path becomes superstructure inertia, bearing shear, pier top and foundation, and the piers can stay elastic. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Isolated period T_eff” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：T = 2π√(W/(g·K))。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: T = 2π√(W/(g·K)).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔震讓橋梁在地震時完全不動，所以位移問題可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Isolation keeps the bridge from moving in an earthquake, so displacement can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隔震週期 T_eff」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Isolated period T_eff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「週期移轉與荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Period shift and load path" is correct?
options: 隔震讓橋梁在地震時完全不動，所以位移問題可以忽略。
一般連續梁橋以固定或彈性支承連到橋墩，整體週期常落在 0.3 至 1.0 s，正好在設計反應譜的高原段，墩柱必須以塑性變形消散地震能量。
阻尼越大，隔震橋的所有反應一定都越小。

A conventional continuous girder bridge is tied to its piers through fixed or elastic bearings, and its period typically falls between 0.3 and 1.0 s, right on the plateau of the design spectrum, so the columns must dissipate earthquake energy by yielding.
More damping always reduces every response of an isolated bridge.

quiz.explanationEn: A conventional continuous girder bridge is tied to its piers through fixed or elastic bearings, and its period typically falls between 0.3 and 1.0 s, right on the plateau of the design spectrum, so the columns must dissipate earthquake energy by yielding. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 週期移轉與荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Period shift and load path: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔震週期 T_eff」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Isolated period T_eff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T = 2π√(W/(g·K))。單墩承載 W = 6,000 kN，固接時墩頂勁度 K = 60,000 kN/m，T = 2π√(6,000/(9.81×60,000)) ≈ 0.63 s；改為兩顆隔震支承、等效勁度合計 K_eff = 3,350 kN/m，T = 2π√(6,000/(9.81×3,350)) ≈ 2.68 s，週期拉長約 4.2 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: T = 2π√(W/(g·K)). For a pier carrying W = 6,000 kN with a fixed-connection stiffness K = 60,000 kN/m, T = 2π√(6,000/(9.81×60,000)) ≈ 0.63 s; with two isolators of combined effective stiffness K_eff = 3,350 kN/m, T = 2π√(6,000/(9.81×3,350)) ≈ 2.68 s, about 4.2 times longer. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構模型中比較固接與隔震兩種情境的模態週期、參與質量與墩底剪力，確認隔震後第一模態以支承變形為主（支承位移佔墩頂總位移的大部分）；同時檢查場址是否為軟弱土層或近斷層，因長週期地震動可能抵消週期移轉效益。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare modal periods, participating mass and pier base shear in the structural model for the fixed and isolated cases, confirming that the isolated first mode is dominated by bearing deformation (most of the deck displacement occurs in the bearings); also check whether the site is soft soil or near-fault, where long-period ground motion can erode the benefit of period shift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: T = 2π√(W/(g·K)). For a pier carrying W = 6,000 kN with a fixed-connection stiffness K = 60,000 kN/m, T = 2π√(6,000/(9.81×60,000)) ≈ 0.63 s; with two isolators of combined effective stiffness K_eff = 3,350 kN/m, T = 2π√(6,000/(9.81×3,350)) ≈ 2.68 s, about 4.2 times longer. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「週期移轉與荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Period shift and load path", which statement holds?
options: 橡膠越厚越軟就一定越好，因為水平勁度越低隔震效果越佳。
隔震縫只是施工留下的空隙，之後可以拿來安裝管線或設施。
optionsEn: Thicker, softer rubber is always better because lower lateral stiffness means better isolation.
An isolation gap is just a construction void that can later host utilities or fittings.
quiz.explanation: T = 2π√(W/(g·K))。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: T = 2π√(W/(g·K)). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 週期移轉與荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Period shift and load path: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔震週期 T_eff」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Isolated period T_eff” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構模型中比較固接與隔震兩種情境的模態週期、參與質量與墩底剪力，確認隔震後第一模態以支承變形為主（支承位移佔墩頂總位移的大部分）；同時檢查場址是否為軟弱土層或近斷層，因長週期地震動可能抵消週期移轉效益。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare modal periods, participating mass and pier base shear in the structural model for the fixed and isolated cases, confirming that the isolated first mode is dominated by bearing deformation (most of the deck displacement occurs in the bearings); also check whether the site is soft soil or near-fault, where long-period ground motion can erode the benefit of period shift. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：方案階段就用簡化單自由度模型比較隔震前後的墩底剪力與支承位移，並把高墩、軟土與近斷層列為需要專門評估的情況；隔震方案要同時提出伸縮縫與隔震縫的尺寸。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At concept stage compare pier base shear and bearing displacement with and without isolation using a simple single-degree-of-freedom model, flag tall piers, soft soil and near-fault sites for special study, and propose expansion-joint and isolation-gap sizes together with the isolation scheme.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若橋墩本身很柔（高墩）或場址為軟土，隔震後週期增加有限，反而增加位移而沒有明顯降低力量；若忽略隔震後的大位移，地震時上部結構撞擊橋台背牆或相鄰梁，造成撞擊損傷與伸縮縫破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the piers are already flexible (tall piers) or the site is soft, isolation adds little period while increasing displacement without much force reduction; ignoring the larger isolated displacement lets the deck pound the abutment backwall or adjacent spans in an earthquake, damaging both and destroying the expansion joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 方案階段就用簡化單自由度模型比較隔震前後的墩底剪力與支承位移，並把高墩、軟土與近斷層列為需要專門評估的情況；隔震方案要同時提出伸縮縫與隔震縫的尺寸。

quiz.question: 要驗證「週期移轉與荷載路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Period shift and load path"?
options: 在結構模型中比較固接與隔震兩種情境的模態週期、參與質量與墩底剪力，確認隔震後第一模態以支承變形為主（支承位移佔墩頂總位移的大部分）。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
縮尺模型只要把尺寸縮小，原始地震紀錄可以直接輸入。
optionsEn: Compare modal periods, participating mass and pier base shear in the structural model for the fixed and isolated cases, confirming that the isolated first mode is dominated by bearing deformation (most of the deck displacement occurs in the bearings).
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A scale model only needs smaller dimensions; the original record can be input unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 在結構模型中比較固接與隔震兩種情境的模態週期、參與質量與墩底剪力，確認隔震後第一模態以支承變形為主（支承位移佔墩頂總位移的大部分）；同時檢查場址是否為軟弱土層或近斷層，因長週期地震動可能抵消週期移轉效益。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare modal periods, participating mass and pier base shear in the structural model for the fixed and isolated cases, confirming that the isolated first mode is dominated by bearing deformation (most of the deck displacement occurs in the bearings); also check whether the site is soft soil or near-fault, where long-period ground motion can erode the benefit of period shift. steps.title: 週期移轉與荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Period shift and load path: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔震週期 T_eff」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Isolated period T_eff” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若橋墩本身很柔（高墩）或場址為軟土，隔震後週期增加有限，反而增加位移而沒有明顯降低力量；若忽略隔震後的大位移，地震時上部結構撞擊橋台背牆或相鄰梁，造成撞擊損傷與伸縮縫破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the piers are already flexible (tall piers) or the site is soft, isolation adds little period while increasing displacement without much force reduction; ignoring the larger isolated displacement lets the deck pound the abutment backwall or adjacent spans in an earthquake, damaging both and destroying the expansion joints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The load path becomes superstructure inertia, bearing shear, pier top and foundation, and the piers can stay elastic.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔震讓橋梁在地震時完全不動，所以位移問題可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Isolation keeps the bridge from moving in an earthquake, so displacement can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 等效線性化與設計位移：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Equivalent linearisation and design displacement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「設計位移 D 與 B_L」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Design displacement D and B_L” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鉛心橡膠支承的力—位移關係是雙線性遲滯：鉛心屈服前勁度很高，屈服後只剩橡膠勁度，迴圈面積代表每一循環消散的能量。設計常以等效線性化處理：在假設位移 D 下計算割線勁度 K_eff 與等效阻尼 β，查反應譜並以阻尼修正係數 B_L 降低位移，再以新位移重算 K_eff 與 β，反覆疊代至收斂。這個流程直接連結鉛心大小、橡膠厚度與最終的支承位移和墩頂剪力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「設計位移 D 與 B_L」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A lead-rubber bearing has a bilinear hysteretic force–displacement relation: very stiff before the lead core yields, then only the rubber stiffness after yield, with the loop area representing the energy dissipated per cycle. Design usually linearises it: at an assumed displacement D compute the secant stiffness K_eff and equivalent damping β, read the spectrum and reduce displacement with a damping coefficient B_L, then recompute K_eff and β with the new displacement and iterate to convergence. This process links lead-core size and rubber thickness directly to the final bearing displacement and pier-top shear. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Design displacement D and B_L” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：等效線性化設計位移 D = 0.25·S_D1·T_eff/B_L（m），阻尼修正係數 B_L = (β/0.05)^0.3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: D = 0.25·S_D1·T_eff/B_L (m) with B_L = (β/0.05)^0.3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼越大，隔震橋的所有反應一定都越小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More damping always reduces every response of an isolated bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「設計位移 D 與 B_L」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 等效線性化與設計位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equivalent linearisation and design displacement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計位移 D 與 B_L」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Design displacement D and B_L” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：等效線性化設計位移 D = 0.25·S_D1·T_eff/B_L（m），阻尼修正係數 B_L = (β/0.05)^0.3。取 S_D1 = 0.6 g、T_eff = 2.68 s、β = 24.7%：B_L = 4.94^0.3 ≈ 1.61，D = 0.25×0.6×2.68/1.61 ≈ 0.25 m；若沒有鉛心、β = 5%，D = 0.25×0.6×2.68 ≈ 0.40 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: D = 0.25·S_D1·T_eff/B_L (m) with B_L = (β/0.05)^0.3. For S_D1 = 0.6 g, T_eff = 2.68 s and β = 24.7%: B_L = 4.94^0.3 ≈ 1.61 and D = 0.25×0.6×2.68/1.61 ≈ 0.25 m; without a lead core, β = 5% and D = 0.25×0.6×2.68 ≈ 0.40 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以簡化法求得的位移與剪力，和非線性時間歷程分析（以雙線性元素模擬每顆支承、輸入多組符合設計譜的地震紀錄）比較，差異過大時找出原因（例如高阻尼下等效線性化失準或雙向耦合）；並確認 β 未超過簡化法適用上限。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare displacement and shear from the simplified method with nonlinear time-history analysis that models each bearing as a bilinear element under several spectrum-compatible records, investigating large differences such as linearisation error at high damping or bidirectional coupling; also confirm β stays within the simplified method's limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: D = 0.25·S_D1·T_eff/B_L (m) with B_L = (β/0.05)^0.3. For S_D1 = 0.6 g, T_eff = 2.68 s and β = 24.7%: B_L = 4.94^0.3 ≈ 1.61 and D = 0.25×0.6×2.68/1.61 ≈ 0.25 m; without a lead core, β = 5% and D = 0.25×0.6×2.68 ≈ 0.40 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 等效線性化與設計位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equivalent linearisation and design displacement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設計位移 D 與 B_L」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Design displacement D and B_L” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以簡化法求得的位移與剪力，和非線性時間歷程分析（以雙線性元素模擬每顆支承、輸入多組符合設計譜的地震紀錄）比較，差異過大時找出原因（例如高阻尼下等效線性化失準或雙向耦合）；並確認 β 未超過簡化法適用上限。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare displacement and shear from the simplified method with nonlinear time-history analysis that models each bearing as a bilinear element under several spectrum-compatible records, investigating large differences such as linearisation error at high damping or bidirectional coupling; also confirm β stays within the simplified method's limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：計算書要列出每次疊代的 D、K_eff、β、B_L 與收斂結果，並明確說明採用的反應譜、場址係數與近斷層放大；重要橋梁一律以非線性時間歷程分析複核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculations list D, K_eff, β, B_L for each iteration and the converged result, and state the spectrum, site factors and near-fault amplification used; important bridges are always checked by nonlinear time-history analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用等效線性化而未做雙向與近斷層紀錄的時間歷程檢核，可能低估最大位移，使支承超過其穩定位移或撞上止擋；近斷層速度脈衝會讓長週期隔震系統產生遠大於預期的單向位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Relying only on linearisation without bidirectional and near-fault time-history checks can underestimate peak displacement, pushing bearings beyond their stable displacement or into stops; near-fault velocity pulses can drive a long-period isolated system to one-sided displacements far larger than expected. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Design displacement D and B_L” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用等效線性化而未做雙向與近斷層紀錄的時間歷程檢核，可能低估最大位移，使支承超過其穩定位移或撞上止擋；近斷層速度脈衝會讓長週期隔震系統產生遠大於預期的單向位移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Relying only on linearisation without bidirectional and near-fault time-history checks can underestimate peak displacement, pushing bearings beyond their stable displacement or into stops; near-fault velocity pulses can drive a long-period isolated system to one-sided displacements far larger than expected. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 鉛心特徵強度與屈服後勁度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lead-core characteristic strength and post-yield stiffness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鉛心 Q_d 與橡膠 K_d」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lead core Q_d and rubber K_d” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鉛在常溫下屈服後能再結晶恢復，因此可反覆塑性變形而不累積疲勞，被壓入疊層橡膠中央孔後，受橡膠與鋼板圍束，剪切時屈服並消散能量。鉛心截面積決定特徵強度 Q_d（雙線性迴圈在零位移處的截距），橡膠的剪力模數、受剪面積與總厚度決定屈服後勁度 K_d。Robinson 與 Tucker 在 1981 年發表的早期試驗中，以屈服應力約 10 MPa 的塑性體描述鉛心，便能合理重現遲滯迴圈。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鉛心 Q_d 與橡膠 K_d」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lead recrystallises at room temperature after yielding, so it can deform plastically again and again without accumulating fatigue; pressed into the central hole of laminated rubber and confined by rubber and steel shims, it yields in shear and dissipates energy. The lead area sets the characteristic strength Q_d, the intercept of the bilinear loop at zero displacement, while the rubber's shear modulus, shear area and total thickness set the post-yield stiffness K_d. In early tests published by Robinson and Tucker in 1981, treating the lead as a plastic solid with a yield stress of about 10 MPa reasonably reproduced the hysteresis loops. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lead core Q_d and rubber K_d” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Q_d = τ_y·A_pb，K_d = G·A_r/T_r。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Q_d = τ_y·A_pb and K_d = G·A_r/T_r.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鉛心越大，隔震效果一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The bigger the lead core, the better the isolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鉛心 Q_d 與橡膠 K_d」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lead core Q_d and rubber K_d”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「鉛心特徵強度與屈服後勁度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lead-core characteristic strength and post-yield stiffness" is correct?

steps.title: 鉛心特徵強度與屈服後勁度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lead-core characteristic strength and post-yield stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鉛心 Q_d 與橡膠 K_d」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lead core Q_d and rubber K_d” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q_d = τ_y·A_pb，K_d = G·A_r/T_r。鉛心直徑 150 mm，A_pb = 0.0177 m²，τ_y = 10 MPa，Q_d ≈ 177 kN；支承直徑 800 mm，A_r = 0.503 − 0.018 = 0.485 m²，G = 0.4 MPa，T_r = 200 mm，K_d = 400×0.485/0.2 ≈ 970 kN/m；初始勁度取 K_u = 10·K_d = 9,700 kN/m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q_d = τ_y·A_pb and K_d = G·A_r/T_r. A 150 mm lead core gives A_pb = 0.0177 m², so with τ_y = 10 MPa, Q_d ≈ 177 kN; an 800 mm bearing has A_r = 0.503 − 0.018 = 0.485 m², and with G = 0.4 MPa and T_r = 200 mm, K_d = 400×0.485/0.2 ≈ 970 kN/m; take initial stiffness K_u = 10·K_d = 9,700 kN/m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查製造商依原型試驗擬合的 Q_d、K_d、K_u 與其試驗條件（位移、頻率、循環數、溫度），確認設計值落在試驗涵蓋範圍內；鉛純度、橡膠配方的剪力模數與鋼板材料要有證明文件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review the manufacturer's Q_d, K_d and K_u fitted from prototype tests and their test conditions (displacement, frequency, cycles and temperature), confirming design values fall within the tested range; lead purity, the rubber compound's shear modulus and the shim steel must be documented.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鉛心特徵強度與屈服後勁度：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鉛心 Q_d 與橡膠 K_d」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lead core Q_d and rubber K_d” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查製造商依原型試驗擬合的 Q_d、K_d、K_u 與其試驗條件（位移、頻率、循環數、溫度），確認設計值落在試驗涵蓋範圍內；鉛純度、橡膠配方的剪力模數與鋼板材料要有證明文件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review the manufacturer's Q_d, K_d and K_u fitted from prototype tests and their test conditions (displacement, frequency, cycles and temperature), confirming design values fall within the tested range; lead purity, the rubber compound's shear modulus and the shim steel must be documented. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支承規格書要明列 Q_d、K_d 的設計值與允差、適用位移範圍與循環數，並要求以原型試驗的第三圈或多圈平均值為準；鉛心直徑與支承直徑的比例須在製造商有試驗證據的範圍內。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The bearing specification states design values and tolerances for Q_d and K_d, the applicable displacement range and cycle count, and requires values based on the third cycle or a multi-cycle average from prototype tests; the ratio of lead-core to bearing diameter must lie within the range the manufacturer has test evidence for.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鉛心太大時 Q_d 過高，中小地震下支承不屈服，隔震效果消失且墩頂剪力偏大；鉛心太小則阻尼不足，位移過大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An oversized lead core makes Q_d too high, so the bearing does not yield in moderate earthquakes, isolation is lost and pier shear is high; an undersized core gives too little damping and excessive displacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鉛心特徵強度與屈服後勁度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.instruction: 鉛心太大時 Q_d 過高，中小地震下支承不屈服，隔震效果消失且墩頂剪力偏大；鉛心太小則阻尼不足，位移過大。反覆大位移循環中鉛心發熱會讓 Q_d 逐圈下降，若設計只取第一圈值會高估阻尼。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 疊層橡膠、形狀係數與應變組合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Laminated rubber, shape factor and strain combination: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橡膠層形狀係數 S」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rubber-layer shape factor S” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 支承由多層薄橡膠與鋼板硫化黏結而成：鋼板阻止橡膠側向膨出，使豎向勁度比水平勁度高出數百倍，同時保留水平方向的柔性。單層橡膠的形狀係數 S（受壓面積除以側面自由面積）越大，豎向勁度越高、受壓產生的剪應變越小；但大位移時上下鋼板的重疊面積減少，承壓有效面積下降，必須檢查壓縮、剪切與轉角三種剪應變的組合，以及在設計位移下的穩定性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橡膠層形狀係數 S」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bearing is made of many thin rubber layers vulcanised to steel shims: the shims stop the rubber bulging, making vertical stiffness hundreds of times the horizontal stiffness while keeping horizontal flexibility. The larger a layer's shape factor S (loaded area divided by free side area), the higher the vertical stiffness and the smaller the shear strain from compression; but at large displacement the overlap of top and bottom plates shrinks, reducing the effective bearing area, so the combined shear strains from compression, shear and rotation and the stability at design displacement must all be checked. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rubber-layer shape factor S” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a circular layer S = B/(4t) = 800/(4×10) = 20; compression shear strain γ_c ≈ σ/(G·S) with σ = 3,000/0.485 ≈ 6.19 MPa, so γ_c ≈ 6.19/(0.4×20) ≈ 0.77; shear strain at design displacement γ_s = D/T_r = 0.25/0.20 = 1.25; their sum of about 2.02 must stay below the governing code's combined-strain limit.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橡膠越厚越軟就一定越好，因為水平勁度越低隔震效果越佳。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker, softer rubber is always better because lower lateral stiffness means better isolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橡膠層形狀係數 S」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 疊層橡膠、形狀係數與應變組合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Laminated rubber, shape factor and strain combination: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橡膠層形狀係數 S」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rubber-layer shape factor S” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：圓形單層 S = B/(4t) = 800/(4×10) = 20；壓縮剪應變 γ_c ≈ σ/(G·S)，σ = 3,000/0.485 ≈ 6.19 MPa，γ_c ≈ 6.19/(0.4×20) ≈ 0.77；設計位移剪應變 γ_s = D/T_r = 0.25/0.20 = 1.25；兩者合計約 2.02，須小於所採規範的組合應變限值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a circular layer S = B/(4t) = 800/(4×10) = 20; compression shear strain γ_c ≈ σ/(G·S) with σ = 3,000/0.485 ≈ 6.19 MPa, so γ_c ≈ 6.19/(0.4×20) ≈ 0.77; shear strain at design displacement γ_s = D/T_r = 0.25/0.20 = 1.25; their sum of about 2.02 must stay below the governing code's combined-strain limit. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查每顆支承在最大與最小豎向力、設計位移及轉角下的組合應變與穩定性，並以壓剪試驗確認在設計位移下仍能承受規定豎向力；出廠時抽樣切片或以 X 光檢查鋼板位置，並量測支承高度與平行度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check each bearing's combined strain and stability under maximum and minimum vertical load, design displacement and rotation, and confirm by compression–shear testing that it carries the specified vertical load at design displacement; at the factory check shim positions by sectioning samples or X-ray and measure bearing height and parallelism.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 疊層橡膠、形狀係數與應變組合：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橡膠層形狀係數 S」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rubber-layer shape factor S” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查每顆支承在最大與最小豎向力、設計位移及轉角下的組合應變與穩定性，並以壓剪試驗確認在設計位移下仍能承受規定豎向力；出廠時抽樣切片或以 X 光檢查鋼板位置，並量測支承高度與平行度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 現場實務：設計者應提供每顆支承的豎向力範圍（含地震引起的豎向力變化），製造商以此核算組合應變與穩定；規格書要求黏結品質檢驗與破壞性抽樣試驗，並規定鋼板最小厚度與保護層厚度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The designer provides each bearing's vertical-load range including seismic variation, and the manufacturer checks combined strain and stability against it; the specification requires bond-quality inspection and destructive sample tests, and sets minimum shim thickness and cover thickness.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：形狀係數太低或總橡膠厚度不足時，大位移下組合應變過高，可能造成橡膠與鋼板脫層、表面裂紋，甚至在重疊面積過小時發生側向失穩（翻轉或滾動）；硫化黏結不良則在第一次大地震時就發生脫層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With too low a shape factor or too little total rubber thickness, combined strains at large displacement become excessive, causing rubber–shim delamination, surface cracking or, with too little overlap area, lateral instability by roll-out; poor vulcanised bonding can delaminate in the first major earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

knowledge.textEn: Check each bearing's combined strain and stability under maximum and minimum vertical load, design displacement and rotation, and confirm by compression–shear testing that it carries the specified vertical load at design displacement; at the factory check shim positions by sectioning samples or X-ray and measure bearing height and parallelism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計者應提供每顆支承的豎向力範圍（含地震引起的豎向力變化），製造商以此核算組合應變與穩定；規格書要求黏結品質檢驗與破壞性抽樣試驗，並規定鋼板最小厚度與保護層厚度。
knowledge.textEn: The designer provides each bearing's vertical-load range including seismic variation, and the manufacturer checks combined strain and stability against it; the specification requires bond-quality inspection and destructive sample tests, and sets minimum shim thickness and cover thickness.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疊層橡膠、形狀係數與應變組合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Laminated rubber, shape factor and strain combination"?
options: 檢查每顆支承在最大與最小豎向力、設計位移及轉角下的組合應變與穩定性，並以壓剪試驗確認在設計位移下仍能承受規定豎向力。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
隔震讓橋梁在地震時完全不動，所以位移問題可以忽略。
optionsEn: Check each bearing's combined strain and stability under maximum and minimum vertical load, design displacement and rotation, and confirm by compression–shear testing that it carries the specified vertical load at design displacement.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Isolation keeps the bridge from moving in an earthquake, so displacement can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 檢查每顆支承在最大與最小豎向力、設計位移及轉角下的組合應變與穩定性，並以壓剪試驗確認在設計位移下仍能承受規定豎向力；出廠時抽樣切片或以 X 光檢查鋼板位置，並量測支承高度與平行度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check each bearing's combined strain and stability under maximum and minimum vertical load, design displacement and rotation, and confirm by compression–shear testing that it carries the specified vertical load at design displacement; at the factory check shim positions by sectioning samples or X-ray and measure bearing height and parallelism. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疊層橡膠、形狀係數與應變組合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Laminated rubber, shape factor and strain combination: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橡膠層形狀係數 S」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rubber-layer shape factor S” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 形狀係數太低或總橡膠厚度不足時，大位移下組合應變過高，可能造成橡膠與鋼板脫層、表面裂紋，甚至在重疊面積過小時發生側向失穩（翻轉或滾動）；硫化黏結不良則在第一次大地震時就發生脫層。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With too low a shape factor or too little total rubber thickness, combined strains at large displacement become excessive, causing rubber–shim delamination, surface cracking or, with too little overlap area, lateral instability by roll-out; poor vulcanised bonding can delaminate in the first major earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單層橡膠的形狀係數 S（受壓面積除以側面自由面積）越大，豎向勁度越高、受壓產生的剪應變越小；但大位移時上下鋼板的重疊面積減少，承壓有效面積下降，必須檢查壓縮、剪切與轉角三種剪應變的組合，以及在設計位移下的穩定性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The larger a layer's shape factor S (loaded area divided by free side area), the higher the vertical stiffness and the smaller the shear strain from compression; but at large displacement the overlap of top and bottom plates shrinks, reducing the effective bearing area, so the combined shear strains from compression, shear and rotation and the stability at design displacement must all be checked.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橡膠越厚越軟就一定越好，因為水平勁度越低隔震效果越佳。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker, softer rubber is always better because lower lateral stiffness means better isolation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 形狀係數太低或總橡膠厚度不足時，大位移下組合應變過高，可能造成橡膠與鋼板脫層、表面裂紋，甚至在重疊面積過小時發生側向失穩（翻轉或滾動）；硫化黏結不良則在第一次大地震時就發生脫層。
knowledge.textEn: With too low a shape factor or too little total rubber thickness, combined strains at large displacement become excessive, causing rubber–shim delamination, surface cracking or, with too little overlap area, lateral instability by roll-out; poor vulcanised bonding can delaminate in the first major earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疊層橡膠、形狀係數與應變組合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Laminated rubber, shape factor and strain combination" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
形狀係數太低或總橡膠厚度不足時，大位移下組合應變過高，可能造成橡膠與鋼板脫層、表面裂紋，甚至在重疊面積過小時發生側向失穩（翻轉或滾動）。
隔震支承有彈性，安裝時的偏移會自己回正，不必控制。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

With too low a shape factor or too little total rubber thickness, combined strains at large displacement become excessive, causing rubber–shim delamination, surface cracking or, with too little overlap area, lateral instability by roll-out.
Isolators are elastic, so any installation offset will self-correct and need not be controlled.
quiz.explanation: 形狀係數太低或總橡膠厚度不足時，大位移下組合應變過高，可能造成橡膠與鋼板脫層、表面裂紋，甚至在重疊面積過小時發生側向失穩（翻轉或滾動）；硫化黏結不良則在第一次大地震時就發生脫層。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With too low a shape factor or too little total rubber thickness, combined strains at large displacement become excessive, causing rubber–shim delamination, surface cracking or, with too little overlap area, lateral instability by roll-out; poor vulcanised bonding can delaminate in the first major earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安裝、定位與初始剪應變」與「常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Installation, alignment and initial shear strain" and "Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安裝、定位與初始剪應變：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Installation, alignment and initial shear strain: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「安裝初始剪變位」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Initial installation shear offset” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震支承以螺栓連接上下連接鋼板，下連接板坐在灌漿墊層上，上連接板與梁底的預埋板或鋼梁下翼板連接。由於支承本身就是水平彈簧，任何安裝後才發生的梁體縮短（預力縮短、潛變、乾縮）或溫度變化，都會讓支承產生長期初始剪應變，佔用一部分地震時可用的應變容量。因此要選擇適當的安裝時機與溫度、必要時先預設偏移，並在施工期間以臨時固定件防止支承在澆置與張拉時被推歪。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「安裝初始剪變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An isolator is bolted to top and bottom connection plates; the bottom plate sits on a grout bed and the top plate connects to an embedded plate in the girder or to a steel girder's bottom flange. Because the bearing is itself a horizontal spring, any girder shortening after installation (prestress shortening, creep, shrinkage) or temperature change imposes a long-term initial shear strain that uses part of the strain capacity available in an earthquake. Installation timing and temperature must therefore be chosen, an offset preset when needed, and temporary fixings used during casting and stressing so the bearing is not pushed out of square. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Initial installation shear offset” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：初始剪應變 γ₀ = Δ/T_r。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Initial shear strain γ₀ = Δ/T_r.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔震支承有彈性，安裝時的偏移會自己回正，不必控制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Isolators are elastic, so any installation offset will self-correct and need not be controlled." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「安裝初始剪變位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Initial installation shear offset”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝、定位與初始剪應變
knowledge.titleEn: Installation, alignment and initial shear strain
knowledge.text: 隔震支承以螺栓連接上下連接鋼板，下連接板坐在灌漿墊層上，上連接板與梁底的預埋板或鋼梁下翼板連接。由於支承本身就是水平彈簧，任何安裝後才發生的梁體縮短（預力縮短、潛變、乾縮）或溫度變化，都會讓支承產生長期初始剪應變，佔用一部分地震時可用的應變容量。
knowledge.textEn: An isolator is bolted to top and bottom connection plates; the bottom plate sits on a grout bed and the top plate connects to an embedded plate in the girder or to a steel girder's bottom flange. Because the bearing is itself a horizontal spring, any girder shortening after installation (prestress shortening, creep, shrinkage) or temperature change imposes a long-term initial shear strain that uses part of the strain capacity available in an earthquake.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隔震支承有彈性，安裝時的偏移會自己回正，不必控制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Isolators are elastic, so any installation offset will self-correct and need not be controlled. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝、定位與初始剪應變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Installation, alignment and initial shear strain" is correct?
options: 隔震支承有彈性，安裝時的偏移會自己回正，不必控制。
隔震縫只是施工留下的空隙，之後可以拿來安裝管線或設施。
隔震支承以螺栓連接上下連接鋼板，下連接板坐在灌漿墊層上，上連接板與梁底的預埋板或鋼梁下翼板連接。
optionsEn: Isolators are elastic, so any installation offset will self-correct and need not be controlled.
An isolation gap is just a construction void that can later host utilities or fittings.
An isolator is bolted to top and bottom connection plates.
quiz.explanation: 隔震支承以螺栓連接上下連接鋼板，下連接板坐在灌漿墊層上，上連接板與梁底的預埋板或鋼梁下翼板連接。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An isolator is bolted to top and bottom connection plates; the bottom plate sits on a grout bed and the top plate connects to an embedded plate in the girder or to a steel girder's bottom flange. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝、定位與初始剪應變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Installation, alignment and initial shear strain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安裝初始剪變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Initial installation shear offset” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：初始剪應變 γ₀ = Δ/T_r。預力梁在支承安裝後長期縮短 Δ = ε·L = 4.0×10⁻⁴×75,000 mm = 30 mm，T_r = 200 mm，γ₀ = 0.15；若安裝時先預設 30 mm 偏移，長期 γ₀ 接近 0，地震時多保留 15% 的剪應變容量。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Initial shear strain γ₀ = Δ/T_r. A prestressed girder that shortens Δ = ε·L = 4.0×10⁻⁴×75,000 mm = 30 mm after bearing installation, with T_r = 200 mm, gives γ₀ = 0.15; presetting a 30 mm offset at installation brings long-term γ₀ close to 0 and keeps 15% more shear-strain capacity for an earthquake. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝時量測支承上下板的水平相對偏移、高程與平整度，與圖面允差比較；張拉與脫模後再量測一次，並把各支承的初始偏移與梁溫一起記錄為基準，納入後續應變檢核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At installation measure the horizontal offset between top and bottom plates, elevation and flatness against drawing tolerances; measure again after stressing and form removal, recording each bearing's initial offset with girder temperature as the baseline for later strain checks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 初始剪應變 γ₀ = Δ/T_r。預力梁在支承安裝後長期縮短 Δ = ε·L = 4.0×10⁻⁴×75,000 mm = 30 mm，T_r = 200 mm，γ₀ = 0.15；若安裝時先預設 30 mm 偏移，長期 γ₀ 接近 0，地震時多保留 15% 的剪應變容量。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Initial shear strain γ₀ = Δ/T_r. A prestressed girder that shortens Δ = ε·L = 4.0×10⁻⁴×75,000 mm = 30 mm after bearing installation, with T_r = 200 mm, gives γ₀ = 0.15; presetting a 30 mm offset at installation brings long-term γ₀ close to 0 and keeps 15% more shear-strain capacity for an earthquake. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝、定位與初始剪應變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Installation, alignment and initial shear strain", which statement holds?
options: 初始剪應變 γ₀ = Δ/T_r。
縮尺模型只要把尺寸縮小，原始地震紀錄可以直接輸入。
鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。
optionsEn: Initial shear strain γ₀ = Δ/T_r.
A scale model only needs smaller dimensions; the original record can be input unchanged.
A lead-rubber bearing always re-centres by itself after an earthquake and needs no inspection.
quiz.explanation: 初始剪應變 γ₀ = Δ/T_r。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial shear strain γ₀ = Δ/T_r. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝、定位與初始剪應變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Installation, alignment and initial shear strain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「安裝初始剪變位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Initial installation shear offset” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝時量測支承上下板的水平相對偏移、高程與平整度，與圖面允差比較；張拉與脫模後再量測一次，並把各支承的初始偏移與梁溫一起記錄為基準，納入後續應變檢核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At installation measure the horizontal offset between top and bottom plates, elevation and flatness against drawing tolerances; measure again after stressing and form removal, recording each bearing's initial offset with girder temperature as the baseline for later strain checks. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫須明定支承安裝與臨時固定件拆除的時機（例如在主要張拉完成後），並設停留點由監造確認偏移量與梁溫；偏移超過允差時由設計者判斷是否頂升重設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan fixes when bearings are installed and temporary fixings removed, for example after main stressing, with a hold point where the inspector confirms offset and girder temperature; if the offset exceeds tolerance the designer decides whether to jack and reset.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在張拉前就移除臨時固定件，或在高溫時安裝而未考慮後續縮短，支承會長期處於明顯剪變位，外觀呈平行四邊形；這部分應變與地震應變疊加後，可能提早達到組合應變限值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing temporary fixings before stressing, or installing in hot weather without allowing for later shortening, leaves the bearing visibly sheared into a parallelogram for years; this strain adds to the earthquake strain and can reach the combined-strain limit early. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝時量測支承上下板的水平相對偏移、高程與平整度，與圖面允差比較；張拉與脫模後再量測一次，並把各支承的初始偏移與梁溫一起記錄為基準，納入後續應變檢核。
knowledge.textEn: At installation measure the horizontal offset between top and bottom plates, elevation and flatness against drawing tolerances; measure again after stressing and form removal, recording each bearing's initial offset with girder temperature as the baseline for later strain checks.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫須明定支承安裝與臨時固定件拆除的時機（例如在主要張拉完成後），並設停留點由監造確認偏移量與梁溫；偏移超過允差時由設計者判斷是否頂升重設。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan fixes when bearings are installed and temporary fixings removed, for example after main stressing, with a hold point where the inspector confirms offset and girder temperature; if the offset exceeds tolerance the designer decides whether to jack and reset.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝、定位與初始剪應變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Installation, alignment and initial shear strain"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
安裝時量測支承上下板的水平相對偏移、高程與平整度，與圖面允差比較；張拉與脫模後再量測一次，並把各支承的初始偏移與梁溫一起記錄為基準，納入後續應變檢核。
阻尼越大，隔震橋的所有反應一定都越小。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
At installation measure the horizontal offset between top and bottom plates, elevation and flatness against drawing tolerances.
More damping always reduces every response of an isolated bridge.
quiz.explanation: 安裝時量測支承上下板的水平相對偏移、高程與平整度，與圖面允差比較；張拉與脫模後再量測一次，並把各支承的初始偏移與梁溫一起記錄為基準，納入後續應變檢核。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At installation measure the horizontal offset between top and bottom plates, elevation and flatness against drawing tolerances; measure again after stressing and form removal, recording each bearing's initial offset with girder temperature as the baseline for later strain checks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝、定位與初始剪應變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Installation, alignment and initial shear strain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「安裝初始剪變位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Initial installation shear offset” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在張拉前就移除臨時固定件，或在高溫時安裝而未考慮後續縮短，支承會長期處於明顯剪變位，外觀呈平行四邊形；這部分應變與地震應變疊加後，可能提早達到組合應變限值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing temporary fixings before stressing, or installing in hot weather without allowing for later shortening, leaves the bearing visibly sheared into a parallelogram for years; this strain adds to the earthquake strain and can reach the combined-strain limit early. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此要選擇適當的安裝時機與溫度、必要時先預設偏移，並在施工期間以臨時固定件防止支承在澆置與張拉時被推歪。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Installation timing and temperature must therefore be chosen, an offset preset when needed, and temporary fixings used during casting and stressing so the bearing is not pushed out of square.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔震支承有彈性，安裝時的偏移會自己回正，不必控制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Isolators are elastic, so any installation offset will self-correct and need not be controlled." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Removing temporary fixings before stressing, or installing in hot weather without allowing for later shortening, leaves the bearing visibly sheared into a parallelogram for years; this strain adds to the earthquake strain and can reach the combined-strain limit early.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝、定位與初始剪應變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Installation, alignment and initial shear strain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
隔震縫只是施工留下的空隙，之後可以拿來安裝管線或設施。
在張拉前就移除臨時固定件，或在高溫時安裝而未考慮後續縮短，支承會長期處於明顯剪變位，外觀呈平行四邊形；這部分應變與地震應變疊加後，可能提早達到組合應變限值。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
An isolation gap is just a construction void that can later host utilities or fittings.
Removing temporary fixings before stressing, or installing in hot weather without allowing for later shortening, leaves the bearing visibly sheared into a parallelogram for years.
