quiz.explanationEn: Removing temporary fixings before stressing, or installing in hot weather without allowing for later shortening, leaves the bearing visibly sheared into a parallelogram for years; this strain adds to the earthquake strain and can reach the combined-strain limit early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隔震縫寬與剪力榫」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Isolation gap and shear keys” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震橋平時要能承受風力、制動力與溫度位移而不晃動，地震時又必須自由移動。鉛心橡膠支承的初始勁度高，鉛心屈服前就能抵抗常時水平力，因此通常不需額外固定；但若常時力超過 Q_d，就要另設可在地震時剪斷的犧牲型剪力榫。隔震縫（梁端與橋台背牆、相鄰梁之間的淨距）與伸縮縫必須能容納設計位移加溫度位移，否則地震時發生撞擊，等於把隔震系統短路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隔震縫寬與剪力榫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An isolated bridge must resist wind, braking and temperature movement in service without swaying, yet move freely in an earthquake. The high initial stiffness of a lead-rubber bearing resists service horizontal forces before the lead yields, so additional restraint is usually unnecessary; but if service forces exceed Q_d, sacrificial shear keys designed to break in an earthquake are added. Isolation gaps between girder ends and abutment backwalls or adjacent spans, and the expansion joints, must accommodate design displacement plus thermal movement, or pounding in an earthquake short-circuits the isolation system. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Isolation gap and shear keys” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：常時制動與風力合計 900 kN 由 6 顆支承分擔，每顆 150 kN，小於 Q_d ≈ 177 kN，鉛心不屈服，位移 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A combined service braking and wind force of 900 kN shared by 6 bearings gives 150 kN each, below Q_d ≈ 177 kN, so the lead does not yield and displacement is 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔震縫只是施工留下的空隙，之後可以拿來安裝管線或設施。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An isolation gap is just a construction void that can later host utilities or fittings." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隔震縫寬與剪力榫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Isolation gap and shear keys”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫
knowledge.titleEn: Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints
knowledge.text: 隔震橋平時要能承受風力、制動力與溫度位移而不晃動，地震時又必須自由移動。鉛心橡膠支承的初始勁度高，鉛心屈服前就能抵抗常時水平力，因此通常不需額外固定；但若常時力超過 Q_d，就要另設可在地震時剪斷的犧牲型剪力榫。
knowledge.textEn: An isolated bridge must resist wind, braking and temperature movement in service without swaying, yet move freely in an earthquake. The high initial stiffness of a lead-rubber bearing resists service horizontal forces before the lead yields, so additional restraint is usually unnecessary; but if service forces exceed Q_d, sacrificial shear keys designed to break in an earthquake are added.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隔震縫只是施工留下的空隙，之後可以拿來安裝管線或設施。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An isolation gap is just a construction void that can later host utilities or fittings. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints" is correct?
options: 隔震橋平時要能承受風力、制動力與溫度位移而不晃動，地震時又必須自由移動。
隔震縫只是施工留下的空隙，之後可以拿來安裝管線或設施。
支承廠商的型錄數值已經過驗證，本案不需要再做原型試驗。
optionsEn: An isolated bridge must resist wind, braking and temperature movement in service without swaying, yet move freely in an earthquake.
An isolation gap is just a construction void that can later host utilities or fittings.
Catalogue values are already verified, so this project needs no prototype tests.
quiz.explanation: 隔震橋平時要能承受風力、制動力與溫度位移而不晃動，地震時又必須自由移動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An isolated bridge must resist wind, braking and temperature movement in service without swaying, yet move freely in an earthquake. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔震縫寬與剪力榫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Isolation gap and shear keys” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：常時制動與風力合計 900 kN 由 6 顆支承分擔，每顆 150 kN，小於 Q_d ≈ 177 kN，鉛心不屈服，位移 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm。隔震縫寬 ≥ D + 溫度 + 乾縮 = 250 + 40 + 20 = 310 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A combined service braking and wind force of 900 kN shared by 6 bearings gives 150 kN each, below Q_d ≈ 177 kN, so the lead does not yield and displacement is 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm. The isolation gap must be at least D + thermal + shrinkage = 250 + 40 + 20 = 310 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：竣工時逐一量測梁端與背牆、相鄰梁、擋塊之間的淨距，確認沒有模板、碎石或後澆混凝土堵塞；伸縮縫型號的行程須涵蓋地震設計位移或明定為可犧牲並可快速修復。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At completion measure every clearance between girder ends and backwalls, adjacent spans and stoppers, confirming no formwork, debris or later concrete bridges the gap; the expansion-joint movement range must cover the seismic design displacement, or the joint must be specified as sacrificial and quickly repairable.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 常時制動與風力合計 900 kN 由 6 顆支承分擔，每顆 150 kN，小於 Q_d ≈ 177 kN，鉛心不屈服，位移 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm。隔震縫寬 ≥ D + 溫度 + 乾縮 = 250 + 40 + 20 = 310 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A combined service braking and wind force of 900 kN shared by 6 bearings gives 150 kN each, below Q_d ≈ 177 kN, so the lead does not yield and displacement is 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm. The isolation gap must be at least D + thermal + shrinkage = 250 + 40 + 20 = 310 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints", which statement holds?
options: 支承性質由出廠試驗決定，數十年使用期間都不會改變。
常時制動與風力合計 900 kN 由 6 顆支承分擔，每顆 150 kN，小於 Q_d ≈ 177 kN，鉛心不屈服，位移 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm。
隔震讓橋梁在地震時完全不動，所以位移問題可以忽略。
optionsEn: Bearing properties are fixed by factory tests and do not change over decades of service.
A combined service braking and wind force of 900 kN shared by 6 bearings gives 150 kN each, below Q_d ≈ 177 kN, so the lead does not yield and displacement is 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm.
Isolation keeps the bridge from moving in an earthquake, so displacement can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 常時制動與風力合計 900 kN 由 6 顆支承分擔，每顆 150 kN，小於 Q_d ≈ 177 kN，鉛心不屈服，位移 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A combined service braking and wind force of 900 kN shared by 6 bearings gives 150 kN each, below Q_d ≈ 177 kN, so the lead does not yield and displacement is 150/9,700 ≈ 15.5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔震縫寬與剪力榫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Isolation gap and shear keys” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 竣工時逐一量測梁端與背牆、相鄰梁、擋塊之間的淨距，確認沒有模板、碎石或後澆混凝土堵塞；伸縮縫型號的行程須涵蓋地震設計位移或明定為可犧牲並可快速修復。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At completion measure every clearance between girder ends and backwalls, adjacent spans and stoppers, confirming no formwork, debris or later concrete bridges the gap; the expansion-joint movement range must cover the seismic design displacement, or the joint must be specified as sacrificial and quickly repairable. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工圖與維護手冊要以醒目方式標示隔震縫的最小淨寬與禁止填塞，並列入每次定期檢查的必檢項目；任何附掛設施的新增都須經結構工程師審查其對隔震位移的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built drawings and the maintenance manual must flag minimum isolation-gap widths and forbid filling them, and every periodic inspection must check them; any added attachment requires a structural engineer's review of its effect on isolation displacement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隔震縫被後來加做的人行道、管線支架或維修平台填塞，地震時上部結構撞擊背牆，衝擊力直接傳入橋台與基礎；剪力榫設計強度過高則在地震時不斷裂，隔震系統完全沒有啟動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Isolation gaps later filled by added footpaths, utility brackets or maintenance platforms let the deck hit the backwall in an earthquake, sending impact forces straight into the abutment and foundation; shear keys designed too strong do not break, and the isolation system never engages. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 竣工時逐一量測梁端與背牆、相鄰梁、擋塊之間的淨距，確認沒有模板、碎石或後澆混凝土堵塞；伸縮縫型號的行程須涵蓋地震設計位移或明定為可犧牲並可快速修復。
knowledge.textEn: At completion measure every clearance between girder ends and backwalls, adjacent spans and stoppers, confirming no formwork, debris or later concrete bridges the gap; the expansion-joint movement range must cover the seismic design displacement, or the joint must be specified as sacrificial and quickly repairable.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 竣工圖與維護手冊要以醒目方式標示隔震縫的最小淨寬與禁止填塞，並列入每次定期檢查的必檢項目；任何附掛設施的新增都須經結構工程師審查其對隔震位移的影響。
knowledge.textEn: As-built drawings and the maintenance manual must flag minimum isolation-gap widths and forbid filling them, and every periodic inspection must check them; any added attachment requires a structural engineer's review of its effect on isolation displacement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
鉛心越大，隔震效果一定越好。
竣工時逐一量測梁端與背牆、相鄰梁、擋塊之間的淨距，確認沒有模板、碎石或後澆混凝土堵塞；伸縮縫型號的行程須涵蓋地震設計位移或明定為可犧牲並可快速修復。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The bigger the lead core, the better the isolation.
At completion measure every clearance between girder ends and backwalls, adjacent spans and stoppers, confirming no formwork, debris or later concrete bridges the gap.
quiz.explanation: 竣工時逐一量測梁端與背牆、相鄰梁、擋塊之間的淨距，確認沒有模板、碎石或後澆混凝土堵塞；伸縮縫型號的行程須涵蓋地震設計位移或明定為可犧牲並可快速修復。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At completion measure every clearance between girder ends and backwalls, adjacent spans and stoppers, confirming no formwork, debris or later concrete bridges the gap; the expansion-joint movement range must cover the seismic design displacement, or the joint must be specified as sacrificial and quickly repairable. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔震縫寬與剪力榫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Isolation gap and shear keys” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 隔震縫被後來加做的人行道、管線支架或維修平台填塞，地震時上部結構撞擊背牆，衝擊力直接傳入橋台與基礎；剪力榫設計強度過高則在地震時不斷裂，隔震系統完全沒有啟動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Isolation gaps later filled by added footpaths, utility brackets or maintenance platforms let the deck hit the backwall in an earthquake, sending impact forces straight into the abutment and foundation; shear keys designed too strong do not break, and the isolation system never engages. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：隔震縫（梁端與橋台背牆、相鄰梁之間的淨距）與伸縮縫必須能容納設計位移加溫度位移，否則地震時發生撞擊，等於把隔震系統短路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Isolation gaps between girder ends and abutment backwalls or adjacent spans, and the expansion joints, must accommodate design displacement plus thermal movement, or pounding in an earthquake short-circuits the isolation system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔震縫只是施工留下的空隙，之後可以拿來安裝管線或設施。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An isolation gap is just a construction void that can later host utilities or fittings." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 隔震縫被後來加做的人行道、管線支架或維修平台填塞，地震時上部結構撞擊背牆，衝擊力直接傳入橋台與基礎；剪力榫設計強度過高則在地震時不斷裂，隔震系統完全沒有啟動。
knowledge.textEn: Isolation gaps later filled by added footpaths, utility brackets or maintenance platforms let the deck hit the backwall in an earthquake, sending impact forces straight into the abutment and foundation; shear keys designed too strong do not break, and the isolation system never engages.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「常時約束、隔震縫與伸縮縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service restraint, isolation gaps and expansion joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 隔震縫被後來加做的人行道、管線支架或維修平台填塞，地震時上部結構撞擊背牆，衝擊力直接傳入橋台與基礎；剪力榫設計強度過高則在地震時不斷裂，隔震系統完全沒有啟動。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
支承廠商的型錄數值已經過驗證，本案不需要再做原型試驗。
optionsEn: Isolation gaps later filled by added footpaths, utility brackets or maintenance platforms let the deck hit the backwall in an earthquake, sending impact forces straight into the abutment and foundation.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Catalogue values are already verified, so this project needs no prototype tests.
quiz.explanation: 隔震縫被後來加做的人行道、管線支架或維修平台填塞，地震時上部結構撞擊背牆，衝擊力直接傳入橋台與基礎；剪力榫設計強度過高則在地震時不斷裂，隔震系統完全沒有啟動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolation gaps later filled by added footpaths, utility brackets or maintenance platforms let the deck hit the backwall in an earthquake, sending impact forces straight into the abutment and foundation; shear keys designed too strong do not break, and the isolation system never engages. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「原型試驗與量產試驗」與「振動台驗證與強震監測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Prototype and production testing" and "Shake-table verification and strong-motion monitoring": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 原型試驗與量產試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Prototype and production testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「遲滯迴圈 EDC」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hysteresis loop EDC” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震支承的設計值必須由試驗證明：原型試驗以實尺寸或代表性試體，在設計豎向力下施加多個振幅、多圈數的反覆剪切，量出 Q_d、K_d 與每圈消散能量（EDC），並檢查在最大位移下的穩定性與豎向承載；量產試驗則對每一顆或抽樣支承做較簡短的壓剪試驗，確認與原型一致。1981 年的紐西蘭試驗就已涵蓋大樓支承（0.3 Hz）與橋梁支承（0.9 Hz）兩種頻率與多種行程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「遲滯迴圈 EDC」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Isolator design values must be proven by testing. Prototype tests apply repeated shear at several amplitudes and cycle counts under design vertical load to full-size or representative specimens, measuring Q_d, K_d and the energy dissipated per cycle (EDC), and check stability and vertical capacity at maximum displacement; production tests apply shorter compression–shear tests to every bearing or a sample to confirm consistency with the prototype. The New Zealand tests published in 1981 already covered building bearings at 0.3 Hz and bridge bearings at 0.9 Hz with several strokes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hysteresis loop EDC” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每圈消散能量 EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Energy dissipated per cycle EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支承廠商的型錄數值已經過驗證，本案不需要再做原型試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Catalogue values are already verified, so this project needs no prototype tests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「遲滯迴圈 EDC」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hysteresis loop EDC”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 原型試驗與量產試驗
knowledge.text: 隔震支承的設計值必須由試驗證明：原型試驗以實尺寸或代表性試體，在設計豎向力下施加多個振幅、多圈數的反覆剪切，量出 Q_d、K_d 與每圈消散能量（EDC），並檢查在最大位移下的穩定性與豎向承載；量產試驗則對每一顆或抽樣支承做較簡短的壓剪試驗，確認與原型一致。1981 年的紐西蘭試驗就已涵蓋大樓支承（0.3 Hz）與橋梁支承（0.9 Hz）兩種頻率與多種行程。
knowledge.textEn: Isolator design values must be proven by testing. Prototype tests apply repeated shear at several amplitudes and cycle counts under design vertical load to full-size or representative specimens, measuring Q_d, K_d and the energy dissipated per cycle (EDC), and check stability and vertical capacity at maximum displacement; production tests apply shorter compression–shear tests to every bearing or a sample to confirm consistency with the prototype.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支承廠商的型錄數值已經過驗證，本案不需要再做原型試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Catalogue values are already verified, so this project needs no prototype tests. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「原型試驗與量產試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Prototype and production testing" is correct?
options: 支承廠商的型錄數值已經過驗證，本案不需要再做原型試驗。
隔震支承的設計值必須由試驗證明：原型試驗以實尺寸或代表性試體，在設計豎向力下施加多個振幅、多圈數的反覆剪切，量出 Q_d、K_d 與每圈消散能量（EDC），並檢查在最大位移下的穩定性與豎向承載。
縮尺模型只要把尺寸縮小，原始地震紀錄可以直接輸入。
optionsEn: Catalogue values are already verified, so this project needs no prototype tests.
Isolator design values must be proven by testing.
A scale model only needs smaller dimensions; the original record can be input unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 隔震支承的設計值必須由試驗證明：原型試驗以實尺寸或代表性試體，在設計豎向力下施加多個振幅、多圈數的反覆剪切，量出 Q_d、K_d 與每圈消散能量（EDC），並檢查在最大位移下的穩定性與豎向承載；量產試驗則對每一顆或抽樣支承做較簡短的壓剪試驗，確認與原型一致。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolator design values must be proven by testing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 原型試驗與量產試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Prototype and production testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「遲滯迴圈 EDC」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hysteresis loop EDC” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每圈消散能量 EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y)。Q_d = 177 kN、D = 0.25 m、D_y = Q_d/(K_u − K_d) = 177/8,730 ≈ 0.020 m，EDC = 4×177×0.230 ≈ 162 kN·m；試驗量得迴圈面積 150 kN·m，為設計值的 92%，在 ±15% 允差內。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Energy dissipated per cycle EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y). With Q_d = 177 kN, D = 0.25 m and D_y = Q_d/(K_u − K_d) = 177/8,730 ≈ 0.020 m, EDC = 4×177×0.230 ≈ 162 kN·m; a measured loop area of 150 kN·m is 92% of design, within a ±15% tolerance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫要明定豎向力、位移振幅序列、頻率或速度、循環數、溫度與允收準則（例如個別支承與平均值的允差），由業主代表見證並取得原始力—位移資料；同時比對第 1 圈與第 3 圈的差異，以評估鉛心發熱效應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The test plan fixes vertical load, amplitude sequence, frequency or velocity, cycle count, temperature and acceptance criteria (for example tolerances for individual bearings and the average), witnessed by the owner's representative with raw force–displacement data supplied; compare cycle 1 with cycle 3 to assess lead heating.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每圈消散能量 EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y)。Q_d = 177 kN、D = 0.25 m、D_y = Q_d/(K_u − K_d) = 177/8,730 ≈ 0.020 m，EDC = 4×177×0.230 ≈ 162 kN·m；試驗量得迴圈面積 150 kN·m，為設計值的 92%，在 ±15% 允差內。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Energy dissipated per cycle EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y). With Q_d = 177 kN, D = 0.25 m and D_y = Q_d/(K_u − K_d) = 177/8,730 ≈ 0.020 m, EDC = 4×177×0.230 ≈ 162 kN·m; a measured loop area of 150 kN·m is 92% of design, within a ±15% tolerance. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「原型試驗與量產試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Prototype and production testing", which statement holds?
options: 鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。
阻尼越大，隔震橋的所有反應一定都越小。
每圈消散能量 EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y)。
optionsEn: A lead-rubber bearing always re-centres by itself after an earthquake and needs no inspection.
More damping always reduces every response of an isolated bridge.
Energy dissipated per cycle EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y).
quiz.explanation: 每圈消散能量 EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy dissipated per cycle EDC = 4·Q_d·(D − D_y). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 原型試驗與量產試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prototype and production testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「遲滯迴圈 EDC」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hysteresis loop EDC” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫要明定豎向力、位移振幅序列、頻率或速度、循環數、溫度與允收準則（例如個別支承與平均值的允差），由業主代表見證並取得原始力—位移資料；同時比對第 1 圈與第 3 圈的差異，以評估鉛心發熱效應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The test plan fixes vertical load, amplitude sequence, frequency or velocity, cycle count, temperature and acceptance criteria (for example tolerances for individual bearings and the average), witnessed by the owner's representative with raw force–displacement data supplied; compare cycle 1 with cycle 3 to assess lead heating. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把原型試驗合格列為量產開工的停留點，量產試驗報告須逐顆列出 Q_d、K_d 與偏差，並與支承序號、安裝位置對照；試驗原始資料存入竣工文件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make prototype acceptance a hold point before production starts; production test reports list Q_d, K_d and deviation for each bearing, cross-referenced to serial number and installed location, and raw test data are kept in the as-built records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只做低速或小振幅試驗會高估鉛心強度的穩定性，忽略大位移下的發熱與橡膠非線性；若量產試驗流於形式或試驗資料不實，安裝後的支承性能就無從確認，只能等地震檢驗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only at low speed or small amplitude overstates the stability of lead-core strength and misses heating and rubber nonlinearity at large displacement; if production testing is perfunctory or test data are unreliable, installed performance cannot be confirmed until an earthquake tests it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫要明定豎向力、位移振幅序列、頻率或速度、循環數、溫度與允收準則（例如個別支承與平均值的允差），由業主代表見證並取得原始力—位移資料；同時比對第 1 圈與第 3 圈的差異，以評估鉛心發熱效應。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把原型試驗合格列為量產開工的停留點，量產試驗報告須逐顆列出 Q_d、K_d 與偏差，並與支承序號、安裝位置對照；試驗原始資料存入竣工文件。
knowledge.textEn: Make prototype acceptance a hold point before production starts; production test reports list Q_d, K_d and deviation for each bearing, cross-referenced to serial number and installed location, and raw test data are kept in the as-built records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原型試驗與量產試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Thicker, softer rubber is always better because lower lateral stiffness means better isolation.

quiz.explanationEn: The test plan fixes vertical load, amplitude sequence, frequency or velocity, cycle count, temperature and acceptance criteria (for example tolerances for individual bearings and the average), witnessed by the owner's representative with raw force–displacement data supplied; compare cycle 1 with cycle 3 to assess lead heating. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 原型試驗與量產試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prototype and production testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「遲滯迴圈 EDC」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hysteresis loop EDC” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只做低速或小振幅試驗會高估鉛心強度的穩定性，忽略大位移下的發熱與橡膠非線性；若量產試驗流於形式或試驗資料不實，安裝後的支承性能就無從確認，只能等地震檢驗。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only at low speed or small amplitude overstates the stability of lead-core strength and misses heating and rubber nonlinearity at large displacement; if production testing is perfunctory or test data are unreliable, installed performance cannot be confirmed until an earthquake tests it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：1981 年的紐西蘭試驗就已涵蓋大樓支承（0.3 Hz）與橋梁支承（0.9 Hz）兩種頻率與多種行程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The New Zealand tests published in 1981 already covered building bearings at 0.3 Hz and bridge bearings at 0.9 Hz with several strokes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支承廠商的型錄數值已經過驗證，本案不需要再做原型試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Catalogue values are already verified, so this project needs no prototype tests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只做低速或小振幅試驗會高估鉛心強度的穩定性，忽略大位移下的發熱與橡膠非線性；若量產試驗流於形式或試驗資料不實，安裝後的支承性能就無從確認，只能等地震檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only at low speed or small amplitude overstates the stability of lead-core strength and misses heating and rubber nonlinearity at large displacement; if production testing is perfunctory or test data are unreliable, installed performance cannot be confirmed until an earthquake tests it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「原型試驗與量產試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Prototype and production testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只做低速或小振幅試驗會高估鉛心強度的穩定性，忽略大位移下的發熱與橡膠非線性；若量產試驗流於形式或試驗資料不實，安裝後的支承性能就無從確認，只能等地震檢驗。

Testing only at low speed or small amplitude overstates the stability of lead-core strength and misses heating and rubber nonlinearity at large displacement.
A scale model only needs smaller dimensions; the original record can be input unchanged.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 振動台驗證與強震監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shake-table verification and strong-motion monitoring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「振動台縮尺模型」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shake-table scale model” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 元件試驗證明支承本身的性能，振動台試驗則驗證整座隔震橋在真實地震紀錄下的系統行為，例如雙向耦合、豎向地震與撞擊。縮尺模型必須遵守相似律：以重力相似時，長度縮尺 λ 對應時間縮尺 √λ，加速度不變，因此輸入地震紀錄要壓縮時間軸。國家地震工程研究中心台南實驗室的 8 m×8 m 高速長行程振動台，可重現近斷層地震的大位移脈衝，正是長週期隔震系統最需要檢驗的情境。完工後在橋上布設強震儀，則能在真實地震中回饋支承位移與墩頂加速度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「振動台縮尺模型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Component tests prove the bearing itself; shake-table tests verify the system behaviour of a whole isolated bridge under real records, such as bidirectional coupling, vertical shaking and pounding. Scale models must respect similitude: with gravity similitude a length scale λ implies a time scale √λ with unchanged acceleration, so input records are time-compressed. The 8 m by 8 m high-speed long-stroke shake table at NCREE's Tainan laboratory can reproduce the large displacement pulses of near-fault motion, exactly the case long-period isolation most needs to be checked against. After completion, strong-motion instruments on the bridge feed back bearing displacements and pier-top accelerations from real earthquakes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shake-table scale model” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：長度縮尺 1/4 時時間縮尺 1/√4 = 1/2：原型週期 2.68 s 對應模型 1.34 s，原型位移 0.25 m 對應模型 62.5 mm，加速度維持相同；原型地震紀錄的取樣間隔 0.01 s 需壓縮為 0.005 s 輸入。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a length scale of 1/4 the time scale is 1/√4 = 1/2: a 2.68 s prototype period becomes 1.34 s in the model, a 0.25 m prototype displacement becomes 62.5 mm and accelerations stay the same; a prototype record sampled at 0.01 s is input at 0.005 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「縮尺模型只要把尺寸縮小，原始地震紀錄可以直接輸入。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A scale model only needs smaller dimensions; the original record can be input unchanged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「振動台縮尺模型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shake-table scale model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Component tests prove the bearing itself; shake-table tests verify the system behaviour of a whole isolated bridge under real records, such as bidirectional coupling, vertical shaking and pounding. Scale models must respect similitude: with gravity similitude a length scale λ implies a time scale √λ with unchanged acceleration, so input records are time-compressed.

quiz.question: 關於「振動台驗證與強震監測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shake-table verification and strong-motion monitoring" is correct?

steps.title: 振動台驗證與強震監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shake-table verification and strong-motion monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「振動台縮尺模型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shake-table scale model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：長度縮尺 1/4 時時間縮尺 1/√4 = 1/2：原型週期 2.68 s 對應模型 1.34 s，原型位移 0.25 m 對應模型 62.5 mm，加速度維持相同；原型地震紀錄的取樣間隔 0.01 s 需壓縮為 0.005 s 輸入。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a length scale of 1/4 the time scale is 1/√4 = 1/2: a 2.68 s prototype period becomes 1.34 s in the model, a 0.25 m prototype displacement becomes 62.5 mm and accelerations stay the same; a prototype record sampled at 0.01 s is input at 0.005 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較振動台量測的支承遲滯迴圈、位移時間歷程與墩底剪力，和同一輸入下的數值模型預測；差異超過預設範圍時調整模型參數並說明原因。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the measured bearing loops, displacement histories and pier base shears from the shake table with numerical predictions for the same input, adjusting model parameters and explaining any difference beyond a preset range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 振動台驗證與強震監測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shake-table verification and strong-motion monitoring: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「振動台縮尺模型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shake-table scale model” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較振動台量測的支承遲滯迴圈、位移時間歷程與墩底剪力，和同一輸入下的數值模型預測；差異超過預設範圍時調整模型參數並說明原因。現地強震儀則要求時間同步、記錄觸發閾值與定期功能測試。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the measured bearing loops, displacement histories and pier base shears from the shake table with numerical predictions for the same input, adjusting model parameters and explaining any difference beyond a preset range. Field strong-motion instruments need time synchronisation, trigger thresholds and periodic function tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重要隔震橋的監測系統至少在橋台或自由場、墩頂與上部結構各設加速度計，並在代表性支承設相對位移計；試驗報告與監測資料格式要納入交接，方便震後由他人重算。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：模型縮尺後若忽略鉛心與橡膠材料無法同比例縮小的效應，試驗結果可能偏離原型；橋上強震儀若只裝在地面而沒有量支承相對位移，就無法判斷隔震層是否如預期啟動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「老化、溫度與性質上下限」與「震後檢查、更換與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ageing, temperature and property bounds" and "Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and property bounds: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「性質修正係數 λ」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Property modification factors λ” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鉛心橡膠支承的性質不是定值：橡膠隨老化與低溫變硬，鉛心在低溫時強度升高、在連續大位移循環時因發熱而降低，製造批次也有差異。因此設計採用上下限分析：以性質修正係數把名目 Q_d 與 K_d 放大或縮小，上限性質產生較大的墩頂剪力與基礎力，下限性質產生較大的支承位移與隔震縫需求，兩組結果分別控制不同構件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「性質修正係數 λ」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A lead-rubber bearing's properties are not constant: rubber stiffens with ageing and cold, lead strength rises at low temperature and falls as it heats during continuous large cycles, and production batches vary. Design therefore uses bounding analysis: property modification factors scale nominal Q_d and K_d up and down; upper-bound properties produce larger pier shears and foundation forces, lower-bound properties produce larger bearing displacements and gap demands, and each set governs different components. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Property modification factors λ” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：名目 Q_d = 177 kN，取 λ_max = 1.3、λ_min = 0.85：上限 Q_d ≈ 230 kN、下限 Q_d ≈ 150 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Nominal Q_d = 177 kN with λ_max = 1.3 and λ_min = 0.85 gives an upper bound of about 230 kN and a lower bound of about 150 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支承性質由出廠試驗決定，數十年使用期間都不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bearing properties are fixed by factory tests and do not change over decades of service." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「性質修正係數 λ」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Property modification factors λ”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限
knowledge.text: 鉛心橡膠支承的性質不是定值：橡膠隨老化與低溫變硬，鉛心在低溫時強度升高、在連續大位移循環時因發熱而降低，製造批次也有差異。因此設計採用上下限分析：以性質修正係數把名目 Q_d 與 K_d 放大或縮小，上限性質產生較大的墩頂剪力與基礎力，下限性質產生較大的支承位移與隔震縫需求，兩組結果分別控制不同構件。
knowledge.textEn: A lead-rubber bearing's properties are not constant: rubber stiffens with ageing and cold, lead strength rises at low temperature and falls as it heats during continuous large cycles, and production batches vary. Design therefore uses bounding analysis: property modification factors scale nominal Q_d and K_d up and down; upper-bound properties produce larger pier shears and foundation forces, lower-bound properties produce larger bearing displacements and gap demands, and each set governs different components.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支承性質由出廠試驗決定，數十年使用期間都不會改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Bearing properties are fixed by factory tests and do not change over decades of service. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「老化、溫度與性質上下限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ageing, temperature and property bounds" is correct?

optionsEn: A lead-rubber bearing's properties are not constant: rubber stiffens with ageing and cold, lead strength rises at low temperature and falls as it heats during continuous large cycles, and production batches vary.
Bearing properties are fixed by factory tests and do not change over decades of service.
A lead-rubber bearing always re-centres by itself after an earthquake and needs no inspection.
quiz.explanation: 鉛心橡膠支承的性質不是定值：橡膠隨老化與低溫變硬，鉛心在低溫時強度升高、在連續大位移循環時因發熱而降低，製造批次也有差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A lead-rubber bearing's properties are not constant: rubber stiffens with ageing and cold, lead strength rises at low temperature and falls as it heats during continuous large cycles, and production batches vary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and property bounds: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「性質修正係數 λ」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Property modification factors λ” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：名目 Q_d = 177 kN，取 λ_max = 1.3、λ_min = 0.85：上限 Q_d ≈ 230 kN、下限 Q_d ≈ 150 kN。上限值用於檢核墩柱與基礎強度，下限值用於檢核支承位移、組合應變與隔震縫寬。數值為教學假設，λ 依規範與試驗資料決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Nominal Q_d = 177 kN with λ_max = 1.3 and λ_min = 0.85 gives an upper bound of about 230 kN and a lower bound of about 150 kN. Upper-bound values check pier and foundation strength; lower-bound values check bearing displacement, combined strain and gap width. Values are teaching assumptions; λ follows the code and test data. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：λ 的組成（溫度、老化、汙染、循環、製造變異）要有依據：引用規範預設值或製造商的試驗資料；分析報告須分別列出上限與下限兩組的墩底剪力、支承位移，並標明各構件由哪一組控制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The components of λ (temperature, ageing, contamination, cycling and manufacturing variation) must be justified by code defaults or manufacturer test data; the analysis report lists pier shear and bearing displacement for both upper and lower bounds and states which set governs each component.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 名目 Q_d = 177 kN，取 λ_max = 1.3、λ_min = 0.85：上限 Q_d ≈ 230 kN、下限 Q_d ≈ 150 kN。上限值用於檢核墩柱與基礎強度，下限值用於檢核支承位移、組合應變與隔震縫寬。數值為教學假設，λ 依規範與試驗資料決定。

Upper-bound values check pier and foundation strength; lower-bound values check bearing displacement, combined strain and gap width. Values are teaching assumptions; λ follows the code and test data.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「老化、溫度與性質上下限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and property bounds: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「性質修正係數 λ」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Property modification factors λ” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: λ 的組成（溫度、老化、汙染、循環、製造變異）要有依據：引用規範預設值或製造商的試驗資料；分析報告須分別列出上限與下限兩組的墩底剪力、支承位移，並標明各構件由哪一組控制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The components of λ (temperature, ageing, contamination, cycling and manufacturing variation) must be justified by code defaults or manufacturer test data; the analysis report lists pier shear and bearing displacement for both upper and lower bounds and states which set governs each component. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instruction: 只用名目性質設計時，寒冷地區冬季地震可能讓鉛心強度與橡膠勁度升高，墩柱承受的剪力超出設計；而大位移連續循環使鉛心軟化時，支承位移又超過名目分析，兩端都被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 震後檢查、更換與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「殘留位移與回復力」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual offset and restoring force” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震橋震後的第一個問題是：支承是否回到原位、有沒有損傷、還能不能承受下一次地震。鉛心橡膠支承靠橡膠彈性提供回復力，但鉛心強度會抵抗回位，因此震後可能留下殘留位移；設計時要求足夠的回復力，避免位移逐次累積。交接文件必須包含每顆支承的試驗數據、安裝偏移基準、上下限分析結果與震後檢查程序，並預留頂升點以便更換。金門大橋馬林郡引道高架橋在 1997 至 2001 年的第一期耐震改造中，就於新鋼支撐塔頂裝設鉛心橡膠隔震支承。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「殘留位移與回復力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake the first questions for an isolated bridge are whether the bearings have returned to position, whether they are damaged and whether they can take the next event. A lead-rubber bearing's restoring force comes from rubber elasticity, but the lead resists re-centring, so a residual offset may remain; design requires enough restoring force to prevent displacement ratcheting. Handover documents must include each bearing's test data, installation baselines, bounding-analysis results and the post-earthquake inspection procedure, with jacking points for replacement. In Phase 1 of the Golden Gate Bridge seismic retrofit, from 1997 to 2001, lead-core rubber isolators were installed atop new steel support towers on the Marin approach viaduct. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Residual offset and restoring force” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Restoring-force check concept: F(D) − F(D/2) = K_d·D/2 = 970×0.125 ≈ 121 kN, greater than W/80 = 3,000/80 = 37.5 kN, so restoring force is adequate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lead-rubber bearing always re-centres by itself after an earthquake and needs no inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 震後檢查、更換與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「殘留位移與回復力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Residual offset and restoring force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：回復力檢核概念：F(D) − F(D/2) = K_d·D/2 = 970×0.125 ≈ 121 kN，大於 W/80 = 3,000/80 = 37.5 kN，回復力足夠。理論最大靜態殘留位移約 Q_d/K_d = 177/970 ≈ 0.18 m，實際震後通常較小，需以量測確認。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Restoring-force check concept: F(D) − F(D/2) = K_d·D/2 = 970×0.125 ≈ 121 kN, greater than W/80 = 3,000/80 = 37.5 kN, so restoring force is adequate. The theoretical maximum static residual offset is about Q_d/K_d = 177/970 ≈ 0.18 m; actual residuals are usually smaller and must be measured. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：震後依程序量測每顆支承的殘留剪變位、外觀裂紋、鼓脹與脫層、連接螺栓與灌漿墊層，並檢查隔震縫撞擊痕跡；與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師判定繼續使用、監測或更換。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an earthquake measure each bearing's residual shear offset, surface cracks, bulging and delamination, connection bolts and grout bed, and check isolation gaps for pounding marks; after comparison with handover baselines a structural engineer decides on continued use, monitoring or replacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual offset and restoring force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 震後依程序量測每顆支承的殘留剪變位、外觀裂紋、鼓脹與脫層、連接螺栓與灌漿墊層，並檢查隔震縫撞擊痕跡；與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師判定繼續使用、監測或更換。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake measure each bearing's residual shear offset, surface cracks, bulging and delamination, connection bolts and grout bed, and check isolation gaps for pounding marks; after comparison with handover baselines a structural engineer decides on continued use, monitoring or replacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接時沒有記錄初始偏移，震後無法分辨殘留位移是地震造成還是原本就存在；未預留頂升點時，損傷支承無法在短時間更換，橋梁只能限制通行，失去隔震設計原本要保障的震後功能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without recorded initial offsets at handover, post-earthquake residual displacement cannot be distinguished from pre-existing offset; without jacking points, damaged bearings cannot be replaced quickly and the bridge must be restricted, losing the post-earthquake function isolation was meant to protect. steps.title: 震後檢查、更換與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「殘留位移與回復力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual offset and restoring force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接時沒有記錄初始偏移，震後無法分辨殘留位移是地震造成還是原本就存在；未預留頂升點時，損傷支承無法在短時間更換，橋梁只能限制通行，失去隔震設計原本要保障的震後功能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without recorded initial offsets at handover, post-earthquake residual displacement cannot be distinguished from pre-existing offset; without jacking points, damaged bearings cannot be replaced quickly and the bridge must be restricted, losing the post-earthquake function isolation was meant to protect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：金門大橋馬林郡引道高架橋在 1997 至 2001 年的第一期耐震改造中，就於新鋼支撐塔頂裝設鉛心橡膠隔震支承。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In Phase 1 of the Golden Gate Bridge seismic retrofit, from 1997 to 2001, lead-core rubber isolators were installed atop new steel support towers on the Marin approach viaduct.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lead-rubber bearing always re-centres by itself after an earthquake and needs no inspection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
